_comment: Classical exclusions applied by BOTH copies of the muhurat engine (src/utils/muhuratExclusions.js and backend/utils/muhurat-exclusions.js). Chaturmas dates were cross-checked across several published panchangs (2026: Devshayani Ekadashi 25 Jul, Dev Uthani 20 Nov Smarta / 21 Nov Vaishnava; 2027: Devshayani 14 Jul, Dev Uthani 10 Nov). The end date includes the day after Dev Uthani so both observances are covered. Add a new year here ONLY after checking it against published panchangs; beyond verifiedThrough the engine says so instead of guessing.
